scope: Catalogue of explicitly registered extensions; not a claim that all earlier unregistered supplements have been incorporated.

entries.merge: Add unique IDs only after source-ID resolution, whole-current-graph item review and affected-chain rederivation. Reject conflicting IDs and missing imports; reconcile changed base first.

processing_rule: Load canonical graph first, then ordered entries for inspection. A pending entry is visible research material but must not supply established premises. Promotion requires recorded full audit and explicit status update; mere file existence never promotes a claim.
